newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BESI SEAL JOINT VENTURE DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BESI SEAL JOINT VENTURE DEAL.

text.p: BE Semiconductor Industries NV said on Wednesday that it had signed a definitive agreement with Germany's L. Possehl & Co and Possehl's Far East operations manager Ho Hung Tak to form a strategic joint venture company named Possehl BESI Electronics NV (PBE).
Closing of the transaction is expected by the end of May.
On January 16, BESI said it had signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture with Possehl and Ho Hung Tak.
"Each of the participating entities will contribute all of its ownership interests relating to the production and plating of leadframes and connectors," BESI said.
The new company will be owned by Possehl, BESI and Ho Hung Tak, who will hold stakes of 50.1 percent, 30 percent and 19.9 percent respectively.
The 30 percent interest to be held by BESI will be effected through the acquisition of 6.1 percent of the outstanding PBE shares from Ho Hung Tak.
BESI said it will receive a dividend of approximately 21 million guilders.
